    [(i : pSpec.ChallengeIdx) → SampleableType (pSpec.Challenge i)] {σ} init impl scheme AuxState adversary =>
  have pImpl := impl.addLift ProtocolSpec.challengeQueryImpl;
  OptionT.mk do
    let s ← init
    let __x ← (simulateQ impl scheme.keygen).run s
    match __x with
      | ((ck, vk), sAfterSetup) =>
        (simulateQ pImpl
              (have this := do
                let __x ← (adversary.claim ck).liftComp (oSpec + [pSpec.Challenge]ₒ)
                match __x with
                  | (cm, ⟨query, (resp₁, resp₂, st₁, st₂)⟩) =>
                    have reduction := { prover := adversary.prover ck, verifier := (scheme.opening (ck, vk)).verifier };
                    do
                    let __do_lift ← (Reduction.verdict (cm, ⟨query, resp₁⟩) st₁ reduction).run
                    have accept₁ : Bool := __do_lift.getD false
                    let __do_lift ← (Reduction.verdict (cm, ⟨query, resp₂⟩) st₂ reduction).run
                    have accept₂ : Bool := __do_lift.getD false
                    pure (some ⟨query, (resp₁, resp₂, accept₁, accept₂)⟩);
              this)).run'
          sAfterSetup
